newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan private machinery orders on upward trend - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan private machinery orders on upward trend - EPA.

text.p: Japan's private machinery orders are generally on an upward trend, a senior official of the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) said on Tuesday.
"Looking at the quarterly change in private machinery orders, the uptrend remains intact at least over the last three months," he said.
The EPA announced earlier that private machinery orders, excluding those for machinery for electric power firms and for ships, rose 11.8 percent in January from December.
Private machinery orders in the January-March period are seen falling 8.5 percent from the previous quarter after a quarter-on-quarter rise of 15.3 percent in the October-December period, he said.

Machinery orders in March, the final month of the 1996/97 business year, are likely to show a month-on-month fall as companies seem to have ordered machinery well ahead of the end of the financial year, he said.
